categories.main_business_segments: Gotion High-tech primarily operates in three segments: power battery systems for new energy vehicles, energy storage battery systems, and power transmission and distribution equipment. The company focuses on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of lithium-ion batteries, battery modules, battery packs, and related power equipment. It also engages in emerging applications such as low-altitude flight, engineering machinery, electric ships, and portable energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced lithium-ion battery technologies including lithium iron phosphate and high-nickel ternary materials. It integrates material science and digital science for innovation, focusing on battery cell design, thermal management, and digital manufacturing with AI and big data. Production emphasizes smart manufacturing, lean processes, and green low-carbon practices, with global R&D centers supporting technology development and product iteration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gotion High-tech serves major international and domestic new energy vehicle manufacturers, commercial vehicle producers, and energy storage system integrators. Key customers include Volkswagen Group, VinFast, Rivian, and leading Chinese automakers like Chery, Geely, and SAIC-GM-Wuling. The company also targets industrial, commercial, residential energy storage markets, and emerging sectors such as portable storage and electric aviation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with multiple production bases and R&D centers. It has accelerated international expansion with manufacturing and sales operations in Southeast Asia (Thailand, Vietnam), Europe (Germany, Slovakia), North America (USA), Africa (Morocco), and Oceania (Australia). Overseas markets contribute over 30% of revenue, with strategic focus on China, Americas, Europe-Africa, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gotion High-tech operates across the lithium battery supply chain, including upstream resource acquisition (lithium, nickel, manganese mines), midstream materials production (cathode, anode, electrolyte, separator), cell manufacturing, battery pack assembly, and downstream application integration. It also manages battery recycling and reuse, forming a vertically integrated and self-controlled supply chain to enhance cost control and risk resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in battery materials, digital manufacturing, and energy storage technologies. R&D focuses on high-safety, long-life, low-cost battery cells, solid-state batteries, and digital platforms for lifecycle management. It accelerates platform-based product development, international R&D collaboration, and integration of AI and big data to enhance product performance and manufacturing efficiency. Strategic emphasis is on expanding high-end market penetration and new application scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of power battery systems, energy storage battery systems, and power transmission and distribution equipment. The company also earns income from technology services and licensing. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to automotive OEMs, energy storage integrators, and industrial customers, with growing contributions from overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gotion High-tech ranks among the top global lithium battery manufacturers, holding third place in global lithium iron phosphate installed capacity and eighth in total power battery installed capacity worldwide. It is the fourth largest in China by installed capacity. Competitors include CATL, BYD, and other leading battery producers. The company differentiates itself through integrated supply chain control, advanced technology, and international market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Gotion High-tech achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 35.39 billion, an 11.98% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 28.56% to RMB 1.21 billion. The company’s R&D investment reached RMB 2.93 billion, supporting sustained growth. Overseas revenue grew over 70%, surpassing RMB 11 billion. The company maintains a stable and expanding financial profile with increasing production capacity and market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gotion High-tech emphasizes high-performance, safe, and cost-effective lithium battery solutions with a broad product portfolio covering diverse applications. Its dual-engine innovation strategy combining material science and digital science enables superior battery energy density, fast charging, and long cycle life. The company’s vertically integrated supply chain and global localized manufacturing enhance reliability and competitiveness. It also focuses on sustainable development through battery recycling and green manufacturing.
